page.overview:
What is Avenger Bolt Cannon?

The Avenger Bolt Cannon is one of the primary weapons of both the Avenger strike fighter and the Fire Raptor gunship. It is a rapid-firing, rotary bolt weapon that is particularly effective in providing anti-armour fire support for forces on the ground.

The Avenger Bolt Cannnon is similar in form, function and name to the United States Air Force's [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GAU-8_Avenger GAU-8 Avenger Gatling Gun], used on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fairchild_Republic_A-10_Thunderbolt_II A-10 Thunderbolt II] ground attack aircraft, which are also potent tank-killers.
